observations: Brown mini fridge with wood-grain laminate finish.
A circular sticker on the top right of the door reads 'GREEN LIFE'.
The door is open in photo 2, showing a single wire shelf and a door shelf.
The interior walls and shelves appear to be white or off-white plastic.
The unit is sitting on top of a white refrigerator, suggesting it is a used or second-hand unit.
The exterior shows some minor scuffs and wear.

claims.evidence: Photos show a clean exterior, but the interior and the condition of the back are not shown.

risks.risk: The compressor may be faulty or the unit may not cool.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on and reaching a freezing temperature.

risks.risk: The door seal (gasket) may be torn or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the door gasket.

risks.risk: The internal shelves or door shelf may be cracked or broken.
risks.proof: Photos of the interior with the door fully closed.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the fridge plugged in and running.
Photo of the interior with the door closed to check for cracks or leaks.
Photo of the back of the fridge to check the rear compressor and wiring.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
